documents.title: NBCFDC FAQ - General Loan Scheme for OBCs
documents.text: National Backward Classes Finance and Development Corporation (NBCFDC) provides financial assistance to members of Other Backward Classes (OBCs) with annual family income up to ₹3.00 lakh. General Loan Scheme covers project cost up to ₹15.00 lakh per beneficiary at an interest rate of 6% to 8% per annum. Repayment tenure is up to 8 years including moratorium.

documents.title: NBCFDC FAQ - New Swarnima Scheme for OBC Women
documents.text: New Swarnima Scheme is designed specifically for OBC women entrepreneurs to make them self-reliant. Maximum loan limit is ₹2.00 lakh at a concessional interest rate of 5% per annum. Annual family income ceiling is ₹3.00 lakh. Repayment tenure is 8 years.
